briefdescription.para: Abstract base class for finite elements in the Marmot framework.

detaileddescription.para: This class defines the generic interface for finite elements, including methods for state variable handling, geometry, degrees of freedom, initialization, loading, and numerical integration. Concrete element implementations must override the pure virtual functions.
